workResult.summary: Admitted Analysis from the pinned main control source, deterministically verified generated Analysis Prompt v2.0.0 and read all seven required sources completely before substantive work. The 2026-08-31 Wake Receipt was durably verified, global reconciliation confirmed Discovery, Queue, Reading and the Monday Program shift were execution-closed, Analysis received an Execution Slot at 13:05:26 and Worker Claimed was durably verified at 13:06:23. Analysis consumed only the three completed same-date Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260831-01 separates standing permission preference from occurrence authority: the reported 113-participant study shows policy prompting can fall while overreach blocking also falls, and 114/140 authored rules select Ask, preserving a later runtime commitment boundary. Q-20260831-02 separates reconstructed role from authority provenance: the reported harness attacks succeed after low-privilege content is upgraded during context reconstruction even where conventional automatic-review baselines are rejected, so downstream review cannot repair a corrupted principal premise. Q-20260831-03 separates rerun, controlled replay and causal repair: an authoritative logical prefix and intervention anchor improve causal interpretation, but external-state qualification remains a separate validity gate and represented-prefix exactness does not establish arbitrary physical replay or exactly-once effects. No prior-day research input, fixed article outline, forced first-party mapping, article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: Analysis 依据固定 main 控制源完成准入，在实质工作前确定性核验 Generated Analysis Prompt v2.0.0，并完整读取全部 7 个 Required Source。2026-08-31 Wake Receipt 已持久核验；全局 Reconciliation 确认 Discovery、Queue、Reading 与周一 Program 班次均已收口，Analysis 于 13:05:26 获得 Execution Slot，Worker Claimed 于 13:06:23 持久核验。随后只消费 2026-08-31 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好生成三份 Research Object。Q-20260831-01 分离 Standing Permission Preference 与 Occurrence Authority：113 人研究报告显示 Policy Prompt 可减少，但 Overreach Blocking 也下降，而 140 条用户规则中 114 条选择 Ask，明确保留后续 Runtime Commitment 边界。Q-20260831-02 分离 Reconstructed Role 与 Authority Provenance：报告中的 Harness Attack 在低权限内容经 Context Reconstruction 被提升后成功，而传统 Automatic-review Baseline 可被拒绝，因此下游 Review 无法修复已经被污染的 Principal Premise。Q-20260831-03 分离 Rerun、Controlled Replay 与 Causal Repair：权威 Logical Prefix 与 Intervention Anchor 能提升因果解释力，但 External-state Qualification 仍是独立有效性门禁，Represented-prefix Exactness 也不建立任意 Physical Replay 或外部效果恰好一次。未使用前一日研究输入、固定文章大纲或强制自有项目映射，也未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Standing permission policy and occurrence authority should be separate governance objects. Policy can route a future occurrence to Allow, Ask or Never, but whenever the decision remains open the final authority must bind the concrete occurrence and be independently auditable.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Standing Permission Policy 与 Occurrence Authority 应是两个独立治理对象。Policy 可以把未来发生路由到 Allow、Ask 或 Never；只要决定仍留到运行时，最终权威就必须绑定具体 Occurrence 并可独立审计。

researchObjects.judgment: Reconstructed message role is not sufficient authority provenance. Original principal, origin channel, privilege class and any trusted privilege transition should remain independently inspectable across persistence, handoff and reconstruction.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Reconstructed Message Role 不是充分的 Authority Provenance。Original Principal、Origin Channel、Privilege Class 与任何可信 Privilege Transition 应在持久化、Handoff 与 Reconstruction 全程保持可独立检查。

researchObjects.judgment: Causal repair requires an authoritative failed logical prefix, fail-closed divergence detection, an explicit intervention anchor and separate qualification of external state needed by the live suffix. Rerun success alone is resampling evidence, not proof of repair.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Causal Repair 需要权威 Failed Logical Prefix、Fail-closed Divergence Detection、显式 Intervention Anchor，以及对 Live Suffix 所需 External State 的独立资格核验。Rerun 成功本身只是 Resampling Evidence，不是 Repair 证明。
